content: Long-running activities in simulations: discrete-event simulation keeps a future-event list (priority queue ordered by due time); each event's handler mutates state and schedules further events (event-scheduling paradigm). Alternatives are activity scanning (check every conditional activity each time step) and process interaction. RimWorld's TickManager instead uses tick lists (Normal/Rare/Long) with ticksGame as the sole clock; the world ticks (Find.World.WorldTick) between map pre/post ticks so caravans progress while a map runs. TickRateMultiplier 0/1/3/... controls speed. Confirmed by search plus TickManager.cs decompile.
